study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individual deviations from normative models of brain structure in a large cross-sectional schizophrenia cohort

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Participants comprising the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ASRB: provides participants with structural and diffusion-weighted MRI, genetic data, and symptom severity ratings for normative modeling in schizophrenia and healthy controls.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Participants comprising the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank with structural and diffusion-weighted MRI, genetic data, and symptom severity ratings were considered eligible.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: a total of 517 individuals remained for further analyses, comprising 322 (223 males) individuals diagnosed with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder and 195 (97 males) healthy comparison individuals.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: ASRB: healthy controls mean age 40.3 (SD 14.0); age range 18-65 years.
